verdict.rationale: Multichannel handling is a fair question for an inbox product, but no Gmail documentation shows SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat channels handled natively beside email. The only related evidence is the third-party SMS Backup+ app archiving texts into Gmail, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
